brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer at the very same corner of the same cell as the spike, touching it
requirements.evidence: No drawer socket offered at the spike junction 0,0|0,1|1,0. After building triangle of pieces at (0,0,0)+(0,1,0)+(1,0,0) the only spike was at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (s8/s86). Notch/drawer sockets were only at -1,1 (k0), 1,-1 (k4) and 1,1 (k2) — none overlapping the spike junction. After placing spike+notch the drawer family offered 0 sockets. check_build meshClash=clear but drawer not placed.

requirements.requirement: One spike at the very same corner of the same cell as the drawer, touching it
requirements.evidence: Spike placed in tests at 0,0|0,1|1,0 only when three full bases meet. Notch-drawer frame requires an empty cell beside exactly two touching bases; its junctions are distinct from the 3-cell spike junction. Configurator refused to co-locate — no simultaneous offer for spike+drawer at same at/q,r,k. Current build has 0 spikes (piece:0,0,0;full only).

finish.summary: Single cell 0,0,0 alone offers no spike or notch/drawer. With triangle 0,0+0,1+1,0 spike exists at central junction, but notch/drawer sockets are at three outer gaps, none matching spike junction. After placing spike, drawer offers =0; after placing drawer-frame notch, spike offers =0. Requirement for one drawer and one spike touching at the exact same corner of the same cell cannot be satisfied under current placement rules — configurator never offers both at same junction, meshClash stays clear only because neither pair can be placed together.
